items.headline: Highlight: No. 13 Alabama's defense smothers Kentucky in first SEC contest
items.description: Luke Metz opens the scoring for the Tide with a pick-six while Daniel Hill earns 104 yards and a touchdown on the ground as Alabama shuts out the Wildcats in the second half of the 45-17 win.

items.headline: No. 12 Alabama overcomes halftime deficit to beat Kentucky 45-17
items.description: — Keelon Russell threw for 188 yards and a touchdown to help No. 12 Alabama beat Kentucky 45-17 on Saturday in the Southeastern Conference opener for both teams.

items.headline: Call Paul: Finebaum answers Kentucky fans' burning questions
items.description: SEC Network's Paul Finebaum answers pressing questions from Wildcats' fans, weighing in on the topics top of mind for Big Blue Nation.

items.headline: Fansville: What would Kentucky fans give up to guarantee win over Bama?
items.description: With only two wins over the Crimson Tide all time, SEC Network's Roman Harper asks fans what they're willing to sacrifice to see another win for Big Blue Nation.

items.headline: Crawford, Zahn describe their love for Kentucky and Alabama
items.description: Hulu's "Chad Powers" co-stars Clayne Crawford and Steve Zahn join Marty & McGee and explain how their love for the Wildcats and Crimson Tide came to be.
